name: smwpatches-midway-point-timer-reset
title: Midway Point Timer Reset
description:
This patch makes midway points reset the level's timer to make playing from the midway point the same experience as playing from the start of the level. This prevents unfairly dying from timeout when you play the level in one go.

(note: the timer resets to that of the last (sub-)level you entered that sets the timer, so keep that in mind when placing the midway point in a different sublevel.)
